caseNameFull: Terry E. CALLINS v. UNITED STATES.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied. Justice SOTOMAYOR, with whom Justice GINSBURG joins, dissenting from the denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in Brown v. United States, 586 U.S. ----, --- S.Ct. ----, ---L.Ed.2d ----, 2018 WL 6272161 (2018) (Sotomayor, J., dissenting).
